reviewScope.summary: Independent delta-only review of the one-file Playwright test correction committed by the owner at 3e2fd8b1c5babdd7a740e5fd57230a16af3dc918 (parent 17e993959153c42813c0800386a73b405ab2bf0c). adversarialFindings.description: The category picker introduced a new step into the Utviklerblikk route, while existing Playwright tests still searched for numbered activity buttons immediately after entry; the Home-entry test also expected six list items instead of four categories. This caused long CI locator waits and a failed E2E stage.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The one-file test repair updates only those entry assumptions, preserves learning-card assertions, and passed all 16 selected Utviklerblikk Chromium cases locally without retries.

adversarialFindings.description: The passing Utviklerblikk group logs substantial scrolling at the shortest viewport and smaller scrolling in some 390×844 cases. Passing reachability tests are not proof that all content fits or that the UX is ideal.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Record the observed overflow transparently as a bounded UX concern; do not misstate the test as a no-scroll certification, nor introduce unreviewed CSS changes during this test-oracle repair. This reviewer accepts the observation for submission to CI only; production UX acceptance remains a separate owner judgment.
